title: Dormant GitHub Accounts Help Attackers Blend In While Mapping Corporate Orgs
summary: Datadog Security Labs is warning of "several overlapping campaigns" that are systematically enumerating corporate GitHub organizations, repositories, and user accounts through the GitHub API.
